chronology.notes: Chronololgy is based on calibrated radiocarbon dates and on pollen stratigraphic correlation with core GIK16856-2 offshore Cameroon, which was dated by correclation with marine isotope stages (Dupont, L.M, S. Jahns, F. Marret, N. Shi. 2000. Vegetation change in equatorial West Africa: time-slices for the last 150 ka. Palaeogeogr., Palaeoclim., Palaeoecol. 155:95-122). Correlation with past phases of expanded tree cover registered in core GIK16856-2 was used to confirm the radiocarbon chronology of 10-BB-02, while giving additional control points for the base of the sequence. The Bambili chronology resulting from peak matching of total tree percentages (excluding mangrove) at both sites is coherent, and also fits with the 14C-dated portion of the Bambili sequence.
